claims.statement: Prompt editing reserves an exact native input/history review before a single mutation and recovers its outcome through reads rather than replay.
Manual and automatic recap are separate capabilities; the automatic recap controller starts disabled.

The desktop offers before-input and after-turn native branches separately from same-thread revert, persists the selected destination with the draft before dispatch, and restores canonical input only for before-input branches.
Complete conversation export uses native Markdown history and source-bound chunk tokens in a short-lived service document; the desktop separates full file/clipboard export from loaded excerpts.
Temporary recap threads select the native :read-only default for absent or built-in profiles, preserve explicit custom profiles, and verify returned permissions and ephemeral status before inference.
Cancellation discards only the exact unconfirmed edit draft; accepted edited-input sends remove that draft without creating an archive copy, while uncertain operations retain their recovery identity.
Unfinished edit recovery and native history controls are presented in Details; an after-turn fork clears the finished source edit, while before-input forks retain canonical input for the target.

Task preferences exposes explicit source- and revision-bound read/unread marks for the current root conversation; refresh never acknowledges results and uncertain writes are not automatically retried.
Tool and file detail reads use an exact native history item with full-thread fallback only when item reading is unsupported.
Explicit ephemeral prediction forks inherit native context, tools and permissions, run with a bounded deadline and cleanup, and do not add automatic suggestions or replace isolated recaps.

When a refreshed active snapshot removes the selected conversation or composer owner, the desktop cancels dictation and preserves the draft under its original owner. It stops a Live call only when that call's own conversation is removed or archived; normal navigation restores the next conversation's draft and unavailable owners cannot send.

After native unarchive, a positive active-list observation restores the original local work relationship without an application restart; opening that work restores the draft under its original work and thread identities.

Archive projection hides every positively confirmed archived conversation, including root Agents and the Assistant. Stored relationships remain retained; live children of a hidden parent become independent roots only in the active projection.

Next-message suggestions appear inline in the empty composer and retain the exact native sampling request. Source changes discard local suggestion state without cancelling the parent conversation or replaying generation, and late or unavailable results cannot populate a replacement source draft.

Terminal modelNotFound results preserve the provider message and typed classification in live, stored and cold history without a Decodex capacity retry; the native item-identity probe reads the existing assistant item without replaying inference.

Ordinary input retains its native conversation and recorded tools when local tool revisions change. The selected Assistant has an explicit safe-boundary fresh-context lifecycle that preserves durable identity, input and exact history instead of forking it.

Persistent Agent identity is independent of Work outcomes; current requirements and exact Result receipts survive compaction and restart without making the conversation's latest reply a Work assessment.

Side chat retains the reviewed source boundary and parent model context while exposing only child turns. It preserves the exact source Agent, provider, Project, role and tool revision, requires paginated source history, and creates no copied Goal or model input. Ordinary forks retain deferred Goal continuation.

Agent preferences lists the newest 100 retained exact-source Decodex attached-branch receipts. Open uses verified current navigation and preserves the source draft; uncertain and acknowledged creation retain recovery identity, and archived branches require native restoration before refresh.

The version-11 client draft stores the current editor and exact unresolved messages instead of alternative editor snapshots. Positively unsent messages can retry their original payload without overwriting later input; unknown outcomes require status reads.

A failed message uses a normal user bubble at the end of the scrolling transcript and an aligned Not sent and Resend row. The reason is a tooltip, with no disclosure panel or pinning above the input bar. Archived conversations do not offer retry accessories.

Confirmed archive discards never-dispatched user input and failed desktop retry records, retires pending questions and attention, and cancels pending capacity retries and scheduled checks while retaining sent history, claimed receipts, Work and the current editor; restoring the conversation does not revive the discarded input.
Native policyCapacityUnavailable remains distinct in persisted history and does not select Decodex overload recovery. Bounded native transport retries do not authorize a Decodex continuation.

Locked input-bar Fork creates and opens directly from the latest visible readable prompt in the current native timeline binding. It uses the existing guarded native fork path, never acquires the original writer, and is unavailable for a stale binding.
After-turn branch recovery preserves the source draft and copies its ordinary composer text, attachments and task references into the new branch without submitting them.

Exact native terminal-turn evidence expires pending question cards. Eligible unsent live-question text returns in question order, with one undoable append in the active composer or a saved draft update for an inactive conversation. Nothing is sent automatically; pending submissions, history replay and misalignment do not trigger a new answer, and capacity failures preserve the draft.

The enabled-by-default Automatic next-message suggestions switch gates requests after newly completed visible root answers. Disabling consumes boundaries without sampling and re-enabling does not replay them. Existing draft text is preserved; Tab accepts only a current suggestion from the focused empty field as an undoable unsent draft.

When connection changes during durable save, the same live never-dispatched follow-up slot can wait and resume its original key and payload only for the same profile/runtime/conversation, while pending requests and compaction pause it. Cancel preserves input and removes its preview; ordinary drafts, restored journals and uncertain delivery never gain replay authority.

Conversation Find opens through Cmd-F or the header, searches bounded loaded and retained live text including folded groups, owns Enter without sending the draft, preserves manual disclosure and the current native text revision, and uses explicit existing older-history paging with incomplete-output coverage labels.

Show in conversation reuses a loaded exact native item and temporarily reveals its group without a query; an unloaded item opens a main-transcript window containing the exact item and up to three neighbors per side in its turn. Native directional cursors replace bounded pages, a fixed return action restores the prior offset and draft, failures retain the visible page, and selected-child/source identities remain exact without inference or fabricated timeline positions.

Related conversations queries an existing resource's exact native type and identity with archive filtering and paging, opens only an exact current local thread, and offers copied native references for hidden archived, replaced or unmanaged owners without scanning historical uploads or creating associations.

The Fork action on a locally managed conversation list row opens the exact source, preserves drafts and reviews the latest completed native turn's own user input through existing bounded history loading. Explicit Fork reuses AfterTurn confirmation without sending input. Cancellation and source changes end the pending review; unavailable/full-history gaps and unmanaged rows cannot supply this entry.

Existing conversation and Work lists expose independent status selections and All statuses clearing, saved by the existing host-local presentation preference owner. Status intersects existing Project/search filters, persists across view switches, and keeps a selected label visible after matching rows leave. Filters preserve drafts, exact navigation and Work detail ownership, and do not dispatch, discover missing history or change native/business state.

Completed-response and selected-text actions create a Side chat and quote the referenced text in its ordinary unsent draft while preserving the source draft. The user sends and continues through the normal composer. Long quotes use marked Unicode-safe excerpts within the composer limit, replaced-source selections are rejected, and selected passages do not rewind the inherited prepared conversation prefix.

The conversation header groups a source with multiple verified native Side chat tabs. Its + action prepares the selected idle conversation's latest completed turn and creates an attached fork without a second confirmation or message send. Switching restores drafts and reading positions, while close hides the tab and returns to its source without deleting the native branch.

After an exact native provider mismatch, the user can restore the source provider or click Fork to create and open on the current provider. Source and configuration checks and durable intent remain; there is no second confirmation and creation sends no message.
The provider recovery branch uses the existing draft handback and durable fork receipt, preserves the original conversation and does not automatically retry unsent input.

Provider Fork progress and recovery use the shared feedback band above the composer with bordered buttons. An uncertain result checks the saved fork identity instead of creating another branch; the source draft remains saved.

Ordinary forks and Side chats retain the source provider and forward its current native model, reasoning effort and service tier when reported; explicit recovery onto another provider uses target defaults.
The source tab is Main. Side chat tabs use confirmed native conversation topics shared with conversation labels, falling back to numbered labels until a title is available.

Automatic titles generate from the first eligible completed user exchange, review after seven more completed user exchanges and ask the model to preserve the current title unless sustained recent focus makes it misleading. Generated metadata is bounded to 36 characters and checked for credential material.

Title inference uses an isolated ephemeral structured request on the current native account, with Luna low only when advertised by the live OpenAI catalog and the source model otherwise. The shared native event router keeps temporary events private; source history is unchanged, and only successful native-name readback advances the title checkpoint.

Private title inference preserves foreground questions and reviews. Native name revisions have a separate guard so an automatic title update preserves Recap and task settings, while a manual rename cancels an outstanding automatic write.

Assistant context retirement preserves Inbox, Work, duties, a usable editor and source-linked history. Saved drafts follow only the same Assistant's acknowledged lineage, including after restart; submitted commands and history references keep original identities. Exact creation and activation receipts govern recovery without blind replay, and retirement unsubscribes without Agent archive cleanup.
